level.title: Mass Casualty
level.tagline: A bus has left the motorway. Thirty casualties in an hour.
briefing: Simulation six. Saturday, 20:00. Ambulance control has just called: a bus has left the motorway. About thirty casualties, the first arriving in an hour.
Paramedics will tag them on scene, so they skip your triage desk. Many of them are critically hurt.
You can call in extra doctors and open surge spaces in corridors and side rooms. Do it now, before the first ambulance arrives.

pass: You set up your capacity before the wave arrived, so the sickest patients reached a doctor while they could still be helped.
A surge plan only works if you start it before the patients arrive.
fail: The wave arrived faster than doctors or beds could be found. Critically injured patients waited, and some got worse while they waited.
Call staff in and open space before the first ambulance, not after.

goals.label: No more than 4 patients get worse while waiting
Fewer than 12% leave without being seen
